notes.title: Football dream team deletion test
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42082303/13ea750337eeaebabf9f4d6c8f390e14ab489937.jpg[/img]
Football dream team deletion test
The new version of the [Euro] area will undergo a two-week file deletion test. This test is the last test before the service. If there are no special circumstances, the service will be officially opened soon after the test. If you are still waiting for anything, please come to the [Euro] experience.

New version features:U5LK9

1、 New coach skill system

2、 Adjust the opening tactical currency to 5000

3、 Adjust the price of upgraded player store to 2500, no longer increasing

4、 Turn off the restraint system

5、 Hot spots: new friendly matches

6、 Player AI adjustment

This test is an open recharge system. After the test, double the number of recharged diamonds will be returned to the official opening, and the VIP experience will be returned in full. Or double the number of diamonds will be returned to the classic mode game, and the VIP experience will be returned in full.

The opening time of the file deletion test: after the maintenance on September 8 - before the maintenance on September 20.

Exchange code rewards during the test. Reward exchange code content: 10 God level coaches

Exchange code can only be used in new games:




Activity 1: competition of hot activities

Remarks: all hot events are single player qualifying

Hot spot activities I. unlimited firepower

Enter the event through hot spots or directly conduct single player qualifying during the event

Unlimited firepower: in the unlimited firepower mode, the game has a large number of skill points, and the players who produce skills and skill books will not appear in the game.

Activity time: 18:00-19:00 on September 10, 18:00-19:00 on September 15



Hot spot activities II. Guild war

Enter the event through hot spots or directly conduct single player qualifying during the event

Guild War: guild war is a skill guild Ranking Competition Based on the total points of the guild

During the event, every member of the participating guild will be given the guild battle points according to the points obtained in the single player qualifying

The points deducted due to elimination in the single person qualifying competition will not be counted in the guild battle points, and the individual points increased by using props will be added to the guild battle points.

Players without guild cannot obtain guild battle points.

Note: you can only get rewards if you participate in the activity. Members in the guild who do not participate in the activity will not get rewards

Activity time: 18:00-19:00 on September 11, 18:00-19:00 on September 16



Hot events III. speed race

Enter the event through hot spots or directly conduct single player qualifying during the event

Speed race: the preparation time in the speed race has been greatly reduced, and it is necessary to adjust the buying and selling of players more quickly

Activity time: 18:00-19:00 on September 12, 18:00-19:00 on September 17



Hot events IV. elite competition

Enter the event through hot spots or directly conduct single player qualifying during the event

Elite match: in the elite match, you can get more tactical coins, and the probability of senior players appearing is faster.

Activity time: 18:00-19:00 on September 13, 18:00-19:00 on September 18



Hot activities v. friendly matches

Enter the event through hot spots or directly conduct single player qualifying during the event

Friendly matches need to be played by betting on gold coins. (please reserve at least 1000 gold coins for registration)

Activity time: 18:00-19:00 on September 14, 18:00-19:00 on September 19




Activity 2: Cup

Activity time: September 12 - September 18

Registration time: 10:00, September 12-18:00, September 13

Entry qualification: 1 Diamond, 1 gold coin, single row qualifying grade C or above (including grade C)

1. The first round started at 19:30 on September 13

2. The second round started at 19:30 on September 14

3. The third round started at 19:30 on September 15

4. The fourth round started at 19:30 on September 16

5. The fifth round started at 19:30 on September 17

6. 19:30 on September 18 is the final



Activity 3: guild War:

Time of the guild's Participation: 14:00, September 17

Guild war registration time: September 15 - September 16

Time: 14:00 on September 17.
